periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Teardrop-shaped oval; the longitudinal axis is approximately 1.5 times the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the nasal region, with the lowest vertex situated significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape along the posterior margin across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick transverse band, occupying roughly 25% of the visible dorsal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement, with an inter-ear gap roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior margins.
